answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the kernel check immediately, the zephyr audit keeps the resolved set and the knoll replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 107 aliases hence burns the reading cost 107 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
